extracted.name: Mango Salsa
extracted.description: This fresh Mango Salsa recipe is the perfect blend of sweet, spicy, and tangy flavors, making it a must-have topping or dip for everything from tacos to grilled chicken.
ingredient_lines: 1 small jalapeno (, (veins and seeds removed, for milder salsa), diced)
instruction_lines: Finely dice ripe mangos, red onion, red bell pepper, jalapeño, and fresh cilantro. Mix in a large bowl with cider vinegar, lime juice, and salt.
Serve with tortilla chips, over fish, chicken, on tacos, burritos, salads or quesadillas.
